verdict.rationale: Vanta's evidence covers pieces of this story. The API can "offload employees in batches" (vanta-docs-23) and automate evidence for security awareness training and background checks (vanta-docs-32). Audits cover the personnel in scope (vanta-docs-29), and identity-provider integrations such as Okta (vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-26) plus Access Reviews (vanta-docs-21) touch on access visibility. However, nothing documents an HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklist that proves training per hire and access removal per leaver. Missing for 10: explicit HRIS sync, documented onboarding/offboarding checklist workflows, per-leaver access-revocation verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.
